TERMINATION AGREEMENT

This termination agreement ("Termination Agreement") is made and entered on 1st March,
2020 by and between:

MR. MALIK MAHBOOB AZIZ sb Malik Abdul Aziz CNIC No. 38403-2182406-1
resident of House No. 58/5, Block-A, Satellite Town, Sargodha (hereinafter
referred to as the "Lessor" which term shall, wherever the context so permits or
requires, means and includes his successors-in-interest, legal heirs and assigns)
AND
ZAMEEN MEDIA (PRIVATE) LIMITED, a company incorporated under the laws of
Pakistan and having its registered office at 94-B/I, M.M. Alam Road, Gulberg Ill,
Lahore, through its duly authorized representative Mariam Saleem Akbar, holder
of CNIC No. 35202-9099820-4 (hereinafter referred to as the "Lessee" which
term shall, wherever the context so requires or permits, means and includes its
successors-in-interest and assigns).
(Each a "Party" and, collectively, "Parties")
WHEREAS:
The Lessor had rented out and Lessee had taken on rent vide Lease Agreement dated 4th
July 2018 ("Lease Agreement") a portion of the first floor measuring 1,100 sq. ft. situated at
Burj Abdul Aziz, Canal View, main Faisalabad Road near 47 Pull, Sargodha ("Rented
Premises").
2. The Parties are desirous of terminating the Lease Agreement and to sign a new agreement
to lease ("New Agreement") out the entire first floor measuring 2,600 sq. ft. situated at Burj
Abdul Aziz, Canal View, main Faisalabad Road near 47 Pull, Sargodha ("Demised
Premises").
3. The Parties mutually agree to terminate the Lease Agreement in accordance with the terms
and conditions set fOrth herein.
NOW, THEREFORE, the Parties agree as follows:
1. The Parties mutually agree to terminate the Lease Agreement with effect from 1st March,
2020 ("Termination Date").
2. The Parties acknowledge that the Lessee has already paid rent for the Rented Premises until
the period ending
June 2020 amounting to total of Rs. 526,024, wherein yearly rent for
the period 29th June 2019 ending on 29th June 2020 was paid vide cheque No. 00007505
dated 2 October, 2019 and cheque No. 00007689 dated 21st October, 2019, both cheques
drawn on HBL Bank, Sector Z, DHA, in favor of Mr. Malik Mahboob Aziz.
3. The unutilized rent for the period 1St March, 2020 to 29th June 2020, i.e. an amount of Rs.
1,7,4024, paid by the Lessee, as well as the security deposit amounting to Rs. 200,000 shall
be adjusted forward against the advance rent and security deposit to be paid under the New
Agreement.
4. The Landlord, upon inspection of the Rented Premises, hereby confirms that the Rented
Premises is in good order and condition and free of any damage and shall, on the Termination
Date.

g

5. The Parties acknowledge that the Lease Agreement shall stand terminated as on the
Termination Date and, except the adjustment of unutilized rent and security deposit specified
in Clause 3 above, all duties, obligations arising under the Lease Agreement have been
discharged and neither party shall have any further rights or obligations whatsoever under
the Agreement.
6. The Parties, their employees, agents, sub-contractors, successors and assigns, hereby
discharge and release each other from any and all claims, demands, obligations, liabilities,
or causes of action, whether known or unknown, arising out of or relating to the Lease
Agreement except the unutilized rent specified in Clause 3 above.
7. This Termination Agreement is the entire agreement between the Parties and supersedes
any and all prior agreements and understandings between the Parties, whether written or
oral.

IN WITNESSS WHEREOF, the Parties hereto have executed this Termination Agreement, on the
day, month and year mentioned above.

For and on behalf of Lessor

For and on behalf of Lessee
